newsitem.title: USA: Dow caps second best week ever with another record - NOV 8.
newsitem.headline: Dow caps second best week ever with another record - NOV 8.

text.p: The Dow industrials snared their second biggest weekly point gain ever on Friday, capping a week of election fireworks with still more record closing highs for several stock indices.

"The stock market was down most of the day and then flipped back in the afternoon. It was a consolidation day after a big week for stocks and bonds," said Hildegard Zagorski, a market analyst at Prudential Securities.
The Dow industrials posted their third consecutive all-time high finish, up 14 to about 6220.
